snippet.title: Your Holy & Virtuous Heretic | Frosty Games Fest 2025
snippet.description:
Featured in Frosty Games Fest 2025! Watch the full showcase here: https://youtu.be/3ff3YxX7Cgw

We’ve summoned up a dark and dithered new trailer for Your Holy & Virtuous Heretic, an atmospheric first-person RPG, showing off the never-before-seen area of Proxima along with characters and dungeon crawling mechanics that will be important in this new location. If lo-fi 3D visuals, the occult and turn-based combat involving alchemy and sacrifice sound like your bag, keep your third eye on this one.

Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2621030/Your_Holy__Virtuous_Heretic/ 

Find more games made in Australia and Aotearoa New Zealand on our Steam event page here: https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45423962/sale/FrostyGamesCelebration
